estimand: Equal-weight paired mean difference across six archived rental matchups, free preview/play; onpool control excluded.
model: Independent symmetric Dirichlet joint paired outcome model in each case over nine (A,B) scores in {0,0.5,1} squared, total prior mass per case. Average case posterior expected scores with equal weights.
caps: Unknown; do not discard or impute as draws. Report empirical worst/best difference bounds. Posterior declared incomplete when any analyzed case has a cap.
screen: One fixed 24-pair robustness screen. Report both directions with the same mass-1 model. P(delta<0)>=0.80 triggers reversal of provisional local adoption; otherwise retain its limited fixed-benchmark status. This small screen cannot prove general noninferiority or human superiority. No extensions, no pooling prior trials, no selection by exposure or outcomes.
